title: Daily student workspace
dependencies: Identity, graph, Action Center, search, workspace, design system
requirements: Unify today/this week, deadlines, registration readiness, course work, study, support and career evidence. Persist context between domains. Students control priorities, reminders and private work; no forced AI or duplicate calendars.
workflow: Open Today → reconcile sourced obligations → student selects next action → complete in native workspace or authorized integration → confirm outcome → update shared Action Center.
metrics: journey completion; repeat-use retention; self-reported tool switching; missed-task recovery; accessibility barriers
acceptance_tests: Two course sources generate one task by origin key; a course assignment links to study and advising without another identity; offline work stays draft; compare preferred daily use with the declared cohort's baseline tool stack.
activation_gate: Daily preference is an adoption hypothesis, not inferred from screen count. Activate only after critical journeys, sharing boundaries and six-state accessibility pass.
design_status: Proposed detailed design / existing design references
blockers: Named owners, repository mapping, scoped tests and activation evidence outstanding

title: Source authority and freshness on every fact
dependencies: Canonical fact envelope, ingestion, policies, UI trust components
requirements: Represent each displayed assertion with authority category, source record, source version, observed_at, effective_at, freshness rule and derivation lineage. Distinguish source update time from ingestion time. Unknown or conflicting freshness is visible, not silently current.
workflow: Ingest → validate authority/mapping → record fact envelope → evaluate policy-specific staleness → display label/details → block stale consequential execution or refresh.
metrics: facts with complete provenance; unresolved conflicts; stale-critical-fact count; successful refreshes
acceptance_tests: A stale hold cannot authorize enrollment; an AI summary cites input versions; a conflict between syllabus and official calendar displays accountable resolution route.
activation_gate: Every displayed fact needs provenance or an explicit user-entered/unknown label. Freshness windows require domain-owner approval, not universal timestamps.
design_status: Proposed detailed design / existing design references
blockers: Named owners, repository mapping, scoped tests and activation evidence outstanding

title: Education graph of relationships
dependencies: Tenant identity, fact envelopes, grant model
requirements: Model person→membership→section→assignment→objective→evidence→skill and requirement→credit→program relationships, plus services/opportunities. Node and edge permissions, ownership and retention are explicit. Derived relationships retain inputs and method versions.
workflow: Resolve canonical IDs → validate endpoints and tenant/grant boundaries → append versioned relationship → update authorized projections → detect duplicate/stale/missing edges.
metrics: duplicate identities; orphan edges; denied unauthorized traversals; graph lineage coverage
acceptance_tests: A tutoring referral can relate to an objective without exposing private notes; revoked sharing removes related search visibility; cross-tenant paths are denied unless explicitly granted.
activation_gate: Use relational canonical tables plus explicit edges if suitable; a separate graph database is not required. Inspect and extend existing models before adding a new store.
design_status: Proposed detailed design / existing design references
blockers: Named owners, repository mapping, scoped tests and activation evidence outstanding

title: Course-, policy- and source-aware AI
dependencies: Graph, approved sources, deterministic policy, provider registry
requirements: Use one gateway that resolves institution/course/assessment/user/provider restrictions before retrieval and routing. Explain official rules without becoming the rule. Allow only policy-approved context and bounded tools; no direct browser provider keys.
workflow: Classify request → evaluate effective policies → retrieve permitted current sources → select approved route → evaluate output → label/cite → student review or human handoff.
metrics: policy denials; unsupported citations; applicable evaluation results; human escalation completion
acceptance_tests: Outline-only policy denies prohibited writing; source injection cannot grant tools; fallback cannot weaken policy; model-generated confidence is not presented as validated certainty.
activation_gate: Resolve existing approved-sources-only policy versus broader personal-context UI before widening retrieval. No student record transmission is permitted.
design_status: Proposed detailed design / existing design references
blockers: Named owners, repository mapping, scoped tests and activation evidence outstanding

title: Zero student records to AI providers
dependencies: Data classification, retrieval controls, egress boundary, minimized telemetry
requirements: Deny official education records and prohibited sensitive content across prompts, attachments/OCR, retrieval, conversation history, tools, diagnostics and fallback. Defense includes provenance-based denies plus classification; pattern scans are not sole enforcement. All provider-bound paths pass an inspected egress boundary.
workflow: Create synthetic canaries → exercise all data surfaces and routes → intercept actual serialized payload → verify deny/no canary → independently review → regression-gate change.
metrics: prohibited canary escapes; unauthorized provider attempts; boundary coverage; critical test failures
acceptance_tests: Test obfuscated/multilingual record, embedded roster, cached context and tool-output leak; prove no provider call on forbidden payload and no sensitive logs; positive permitted public cases still work.
activation_gate: Zero observed failures in a specified corpus is a release criterion, not universal proof of immunity. Existing unit suite is not live transport evidence.
design_status: Proposed detailed design / existing design references
blockers: Named owners, repository mapping, scoped tests and activation evidence outstanding

title: Migration factory safer than staying
dependencies: Inventory, mappings, reconciliation, support, cutover authority
requirements: Compare staying and migration risks using documented integrity, operational, security, accessibility, cost and continuity evidence. Factory templates discovery, extraction, transformation, rehearsals, exceptions, training, coexistence and exit. Migrate by domain rather than blanket authority.
workflow: Baseline incumbent risk → profile/extract → map → rehearse → reconcile → review comparative risk → approve or defer bounded cutover.
metrics: rehearsal defects; critical differences; measured recovery; migration toil; documented residual risk
acceptance_tests: Equal counts with a changed grade fail; missing historical term blocks relevant transfer; denied access or recovery gap triggers no-go; staying risk is not asserted without institution evidence.
activation_gate: Replacement safer than staying is a decision supported by comparative evidence, not a slogan. Institution approves residual risk and transfer scope.
design_status: Proposed detailed design / existing design references
blockers: Named owners, repository mapping, scoped tests and activation evidence outstanding

title: Reconciliation and recovery in every domain
dependencies: Versioned snapshots, mappings, command ledger, recovery checkpoints
requirements: Define per-domain comparisons for records, statuses, relationships, totals and meaning. Support stop, route rollback, restore, replay, compensation and forward correction; not every official transaction can legally or technically be undone. Preserve acknowledged post-checkpoint writes.
workflow: Snapshot → semantic compare → classify/assign differences → resolve → rerun → approve; on failure stop affected writes → authorized recovery → reconcile again.
metrics: unresolved critical mismatch; drift age; recovery drill result; post-checkpoint write coverage
acceptance_tests: Grades, seats, credits and account balances have domain-specific tests; rollback cannot erase a confirmed grade or payment; external receipt survives retry/recovery.
activation_gate: Every activated domain needs tested recovery semantics. Do not promise literal undo for irreversible transactions; require institution-approved compensation paths.
design_status: Proposed detailed design / existing design references
blockers: Named owners, repository mapping, scoped tests and activation evidence outstanding

title: Trusted consent and sharing
dependencies: Grants, classification, legal authority, revocation propagation
requirements: Private workspace is private by default. Student sharing selects recipient, items/category, purpose and duration. Distinguish optional grants from institution-authorized record processing; consent cannot override prohibition. Enforce on reads, traversal, search, exports, agents and installs.
workflow: Preview precise scope → authorize grant → log recipient access → student views sharing dashboard → revoke/expire → invalidate derivatives and future access.
metrics: grant clarity; revocation propagation; unauthorized read attempts; student comprehension; unresolved supplier deletions
acceptance_tests: Advisor sees selected plan but not private notes; family grant expires; app uninstall revokes tokens; already downloaded copies receive accurate limits and supplier follow-up rather than false erasure claims.
activation_gate: Revocation stops future authorized access; copies and legally retained official records require explicit disposition. Qualified review sets lawful/policy boundaries.
design_status: Proposed detailed design / existing design references
blockers: Named owners, repository mapping, scoped tests and activation evidence outstanding

title: Tenant isolation proven per table in CI
dependencies: Schema discovery, policy manifest, test identities, CI
requirements: Discover tables/views/functions/storage scopes from actual schemas. Register tenant/private/global scope with approved rationale. Fail CI on missing classifications or policies. Test SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, mutable tenant/role fields, RPC definer paths, services and company-role separation.
workflow: Schema change → compare manifest → generate role/tenant negative fixtures → run DB tests → publish table-operation results → independently review exceptions.
metrics: covered sensitive table operations; unclassified objects; unauthorized grants; failing denials
acceptance_tests: Tenant A cannot access B; company role cannot see records; forged tenant insert/update fails; legitimate owner succeeds; global catalogs expose only approved fields.
activation_gate: Per-table proof is mandatory but not sufficient: test APIs, storage, search, caches, queues and exports too. No actual CI execution is claimed in this blueprint.
design_status: Proposed detailed design / existing design references
blockers: Named owners, repository mapping, scoped tests and activation evidence outstanding

title: Evidence-backed Trust Center
dependencies: Control register, evidence storage, approved claims, supplier inventory
requirements: Public layer shows scoped policies, registries, accessibility/status/incident routes and accurate capability states. Controlled procurement room provides dated authorized evidence. Every claim links control, owner, scope, reviewer and expiry; no raw customer evidence in public pages.
workflow: Collect control evidence → review claim → publish appropriate disclosure → track expiry/change → refresh or withdraw unsupported claim.
metrics: valid claim/evidence links; expired claims; questionnaire turnaround; open evidence gaps
acceptance_tests: A planned control cannot show certified; supplier reports do not certify Semester; expired restore evidence prompts re-review; buyer answers essential data-flow questions unaided.
activation_gate: Certification and compliance wording need specific external/legal basis. HECVAT completion is not certification.
design_status: Proposed detailed design / existing design references
blockers: Named owners, repository mapping, scoped tests and activation evidence outstanding

title: One design system across product, site and ops
dependencies: Tokens, components, trust language, process testing
requirements: Reuse shared semantic tokens, components, navigation, action previews, provenance labels and six-state patterns. Domain density changes layout not identity or trust semantics. Maintain versioning, visual tests, accessibility contract and documented exceptions.
workflow: Inventory surfaces → map shared patterns → replace divergences → automated checks + manual process review → version package → staged adoption.
metrics: component reuse; unreviewed exceptions; visual regressions; critical accessible process pass
acceptance_tests: Site cannot promise a state product does not label; ops action preview uses same semantics; keyboard/screen-reader workflow passes across surfaces; themes retain contrast.
activation_gate: Design-system compliance does not establish whole-product accessibility. Existing assets must be inspected before creating replacements.
design_status: Proposed detailed design / existing design references
blockers: Named owners, repository mapping, scoped tests and activation evidence outstanding

title: Implementation factory: signature to launch
dependencies: Signed scope, SSO, data access, policy, support, release gates
requirements: Use reusable tenant templates, role/policy bundles, onboarding questionnaire, integration harness, mapping studio, training and launch communications. Signature starts delivery intake; readiness depends on customer/security/procurement prerequisites and approved workflow scope.
workflow: Signed handoff → readiness check → tenant/SSO → sandbox integration/mapping → policy approval → train → rehearse → launch cohort → monitor.
metrics: signed-to-ready time; ready-to-launch time; blocked days by owner; defect/support load
acceptance_tests: Incomplete source access stops clocked readiness and creates an owned blocker; launch without isolation/rollback evidence fails; signed scope traces to enabled flags.
activation_gate: Illustrative 4–6-week launch window is a planning target for bounded prepared workflows, not universal SLA or full-SIS replacement promise.

title: Pilot-to-annual with signed measures
dependencies: Metric definitions, baseline, cohort, agreed scope and support
requirements: Before pilot, sign measurement appendix specifying eligible cohort, baseline, sources, formulas, thresholds, privacy, observation window, limitations, commercial decision and owners. Allow go/extend/remediate/stop; no automatic annual conversion.
workflow: Agree measures → baseline → controlled activation → recurring review → close evidence window → jointly validate → annual decision and new scope authorization.
metrics: signed-measure completeness; sponsor-validated outcomes; pilot support cost; conversion/extension reasons
acceptance_tests: Denominator excludes neither inconvenient users nor outages silently; changed success criteria require signed version; result shortfall triggers decision not retroactive threshold edits.
activation_gate: Thresholds/prices are unset until approved; conversion is commercial/institutional authorization, not proof of causal educational impact.
design_status: Proposed detailed design / existing design references
blockers: Named owners, repository mapping, scoped tests and activation evidence outstanding

title: Real-cohort outcome evidence
dependencies: Authorized real data, approved protocol, privacy, metric lineage
requirements: Prespecify cohort, baseline, outcomes, attrition/missing-data handling and comparison design. Separate usage, workflow completion, reported clarity, staff efficiency and educational outcomes. Review research governance and applicable ethics requirements with institution. No fabricated cohort results.
workflow: Approve protocol → enroll/authorize → baseline → collect minimal events/surveys → validate completeness → analyze uncertainty/confounding → institution review → scoped publish.
metrics: completion; clarity; support friction; staff time; attrition; uncertainty; adverse effects
acceptance_tests: Replayed events do not inflate success; missing users remain accounted for; observational findings are not causal claims; small-group disclosure is protected.
activation_gate: No real cohort dataset or effect estimate supplied here. Evidence requires authorized data and protocol, not synthetic dashboard numbers.
design_status: Proposed detailed design / existing design references
blockers: Named owners, repository mapping, scoped tests and activation evidence outstanding

title: LTI, OneRoster, Edu-API and SIS interoperability

requirements: Implement standards and vendor adapters as versioned boundary layers. Declare LTI tool/platform role and individual Advantage services, OneRoster binding/service profiles, Edu-API published version/status, and SIS supported entities/directions. Separate implement/test/deploy/certify states.

acceptance_tests: Wrong issuer/deployment launch fails; repeated roster batch is idempotent; unsupported SIS write remains disabled; schema drift quarantines records.

title: Developer platform and scoped installs
dependencies: API contracts, grants, sandbox, events, review program
requirements: Provide versioned APIs/events, scoped app credentials, synthetic sandboxes, documentation, signed webhooks and deprecation. Install requires tenant approval plus student grant for private work; no broad service credential sharing. Semester-reviewed app badge has explicit tests/scope/expiry.
workflow: Register developer → assess app/scopes → sandbox tests → security/privacy/accessibility review → tenant install → student grant if needed → monitor/revoke.
metrics: scoped installs; contract test pass; revoked-token denials; deprecated API usage; app incidents
acceptance_tests: App cannot read outside grants or call unauthorized writes; uninstall invalidates access; scope expansion requires fresh review; webhook verification prevents forged events.
activation_gate: Build full interface design now; ecosystem production activation waits for platform and partner assurance. Existing plan labels ecosystem post-pilot, not deployed.

title: Marketplace governed by same consent
dependencies: Developer installs, shared grants, moderation, commerce controls
requirements: Listings expose provider, functions, exact data scopes, regions, retention, support, price terms if applicable and evidence badge limits. No marketplace-specific bypass of permission model. Review user content, fraud, accessibility, disputes and payments through authorized processors.

acceptance_tests: Paid app gets no extra record rights; app update cannot expand access silently; delisted app access follows incident/offboarding policy; reviews reveal no private academic records.

title: Company runs on Semester
dependencies: Ops identity boundary, controls, approved external adapters
requirements: Run sales handoff, delivery, trust evidence, customer success, incident work, planning and renewal queues in shared workspace. Keep company data isolated from student tenants. External specialist tools may execute identity, banking/payments, code hosting or legal functions through scoped integrations.

acceptance_tests: Support resolves tenant configuration without browsing student records; finance approval does not grant academic access; external service failure is surfaced/recoverable.
activation_gate: Nobody leaves the product means unified operational context, not eliminating necessary external systems or lawful approvals. No blanket student-data superuser.

title: Accessibility as product feature
dependencies: Shared components, manual tests, disabled-user feedback
requirements: Target WCAG 2.2 AA with complete-process reviews; add user-controlled pacing, focus, reminders, reduced motion and alternatives. Provide accessible documents, charts, authentication, error recovery and institution support. Cognitive support cannot become coercive monitoring.
workflow: Co-design needs → implement semantics/options → automated checks → keyboard/assistive technology → disabled-user validation → remediate → retest.
metrics: critical process success; blocker age; support resolution; regression rate; user-reported usability
acceptance_tests: Registration/tutoring/study workflows work without mouse; drag has alternative; alerts are understandable; opting out of support has no penalty; offline/errors remain accessible.
activation_gate: Conformance is scoped tested evidence, not inferred from tokens or a spot check. Never publish unverified ACR/conformance claims.
design_status: Proposed detailed design / existing design references

title: Renewal evidence and long relationships
dependencies: Signed measures, controls, outcomes, cost/support, export rights
requirements: Maintain per-account evidence over terms: goals, role adoption, outcomes, accessibility, incidents, integration health, delivery costs, support and change requests. Renewal/expansion reviews include unresolved risks, portability and planned work with separate authority gates.
workflow: Baseline goals → recurring sponsor review → track value/harms → prepare renewal evidence → jointly validate → renew/adjust/exit → approve new domain separately.
metrics: verified goal progress; unresolved issues; renewal/expansion reasons; implementation cost; exit quality
acceptance_tests: Renewal pack separates actuals/estimates and includes outages/attrition; no student-private content in commercial reporting; customer can export and exit without coercion.
activation_gate: Long relationships are earned through measured value, trust and portability, not forced lock-in or optimistic case-study claims.
